name: ML-ITW
description: ML-ITW (Multilingual In-The-Wild) is a multilingual speech deepfake detection dataset covering 14 languages, seven platforms, and 180 public figures, designed to evaluate the generalization of detection methods under real-world acoustic conditions.
reputation: A specialized multilingual deepfake detection dataset that is useful for robustness studies, but it is not yet a widely established benchmark with extensive public leaderboard usage.
notes: Dataset publicly available; highlights performance degradation of detectors in real-world scenarios.
